description:
Risk gate for a coin from three public signals: the Crypto Fear and Greed index and its change, predicted perpetual funding across venues and the 4h EMA trend on Binance spot, combined into risk_on, neutral or risk_off with the reasons. 0.05 USDC base (new payers 0.075, >10 payments 0.035; 1 pack call).
After: POST /signal with the bias the gate allows (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Token from buy_signal_pack, buy_subscription (pro/desk) or buy_enterprise instead of paying per call.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from: the payment-required error quotes your tier (0 payments +50 %, 1-10 base, >10 -30 %) and, from the third payment, an upgrade with your own spend.

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

name: sentiment_gate
title: TradeSignal · sentiment gate
